From 27990181031fdcdbe0f7c46011f6404e5d116386 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Charles Keepax <ckeepax@opensource.cirrus.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:17:07 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: SDCA: Add allocation failure check for Entity name

Currently find_sdca_entity_iot() can allocate a string for the
Entity name but it doesn't check if that allocation succeeded.
Add the missing NULL check after the allocation.

Fixes: 48fa77af2f4a ("ASoC: SDCA: Add terminal type into input/output widget name")
Signed-off-by: Charles Keepax <ckeepax@opensource.cirrus.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260303141707.3841635-1-ckeepax@opensource.cirrus.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/sdca/sdca_functions.c b/sound/soc/sdca/sdca_functions.c
index 95b67bb904c3..e0ed593697ba 100644
--- a/sound/soc/sdca/sdca_functions.c
+++ b/sound/soc/sdca/sdca_functions.c
@@ -1156,9 +1156,12 @@ static int find_sdca_entity_iot(struct device *dev,
 	if (!terminal->is_dataport) {
 		const char *type_name = sdca_find_terminal_name(terminal->type);
 
-		if (type_name)
+		if (type_name) {
 			entity->label = devm_kasprintf(dev, GFP_KERNEL, "%s %s",
 						       entity->label, type_name);
+			if (!entity->label)
+				return -ENOMEM;
+		}
 	}
 
 	ret = fwnode_property_read_u32(entity_node,
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `sound/soc/sdca/sdca_functions.c`, to add a missing allocation failure check for a dynamically allocated entity name string.

- **In `find_sdca_entity_iot()`**: When `devm_kasprintf()` is called to construct a new entity label by appending a terminal type name, the return value (`entity->label`) is now checked for `NULL`. If the allocation fails, the function immediately returns `-ENOMEM` instead of continuing with a potentially null pointer.

- **Relationship**: This fix prevents a null pointer dereference that could occur if memory allocation fails during the construction of the widget name. The new check ensures proper error handling before any subsequent use of the label.

Root cause:
Missing NULL check after memory allocation (devm_kasprintf) for entity label in `find_sdca_entity_iot()`, which can lead to a null pointer dereference if the allocation fails.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
<text>
entity->label = devm_kasprintf(dev, GFP_KERNEL, "%s %s",
						       entity->label, type_name);
</text>
Reason:
The return value of `devm_kasprintf` is assigned directly to `entity->label` without checking if the allocation succeeded. If memory allocation fails, `entity->label` becomes NULL, and subsequent usage (e.g., in `dev_dbg` or error messages) will cause a null pointer dereference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
<text>
if (type_name) {
	entity->label = devm_kasprintf(dev, GFP_KERNEL, "%s %s",
				       entity->label, type_name);
	if (!entity->label)
		return -ENOMEM;
}
</text>
Reason:
The fix adds a NULL check after the `devm_kasprintf` call. If the allocation fails, the function returns `-ENOMEM` immediately, preventing any null pointer dereference of `entity->label`. The braces around the block are also added to properly enclose the new check.
